requirements.evidence: Members tabs are missing entirely: no change to App\Livewire\Entity\Members, so there is no activeTab, no setActiveTab and no tablist. app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:108-115 declares an Eloquent\Collection return type but returns `collect()`, which is a Support\Collection. render() (line 199) reads accessGrants on every render, so the page throws a TypeError whenever accessQueueId is null, including the first load. rename() at line 137 passes `null` as the slug, so the slug is never re-derived. The contract is broken: `editingQueue` (bool, line 40) instead of `editingQueueId`, and startRename()/toggleActive() take no $id (lines 117 and 154). The rename form is never rendered in queues.blade.php. Rows are `<div class="box p-2" wire:click=...>` (view line 29), not the required button. Serve render() uses findOrFail (Serve.php:288), so a foreign id gives a 404 where the task asks for ui.serve_empty. callNext has no rate limit. The navbar uses `@can('\App\Models\Queue::class', $currentEntity)` (layout line 379), which is not a valid ability, so the Queues link never shows.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes do go through the CreateQueue, UpdateQueue, SetQueueAccess and CallNextTicket actions, and #[Validate] is used on name and renameName. But many strings are hard-coded English instead of lang keys: 'Active'/'Inactive', 'Cancel', 'Confirm', 'Grant', 'Revoke', 'Serve Tickets', 'Select queue:', 'Call next', 'No tickets.', and the table headers. The view runs a query in @php (queues.blade.php:38). Serve.php:257-261 hand-rolls the grant check instead of using the `call` policy. Most buttons have no aria-labels. No docs or CHANGELOG updates.

security.evidence: Mutating actions resolve the queue scoped to the entity and authorize it (Queues.php:130-131, 156-157, 180-182; Serve.php:271-272). But Serve render() (Serve.php:287-306) lists tickets for any entity queue in selectedQueueId without checking `call`, so an employee can set the property and read the waiting list of a queue they have no grant for. lastCalledTicketId is not #[Locked] (line 238). `mode` is not validated: `CallMode::from` with a tampered value throws a ValueError (500). The required rate limit on callNext is missing.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no tests. There is no feature test for either component, no unauthorized-call test and no tamper test, although conventions.md requires them.

simplicity.evidence: The components are mostly direct. However, Serve.php:261 runs one QueueAccess query per queue (N+1) and duplicates the policy instead of using Gate/`can('call')`. Unused imports in Serve (Gate, Ticket, Queue, UserRole) and Queues (Gate). routes/web.php:570-571 imports Queues and Serve and then uses fully qualified names anyway (lines 579-580).

readability.evidence: serve.blade.php:527-529 gives each mode button two `class` attributes, so the active style never applies. The owner/admin role check uses `->value` with strict in_array in Serve.php:257 but compares enums directly in queues.blade.php:484, and the two cannot both be right. `queues_toggle_message` reads 'You are about to :queue.' The view uses undefined keys `ui.call` and `ui.close`. Queries are inlined in the view.

scope.evidence: Every file touched (two components, two views, lang files, routes, navbar) serves the task. There are no unrelated edits; the change is incomplete rather than out of scope.

issues.explanation: getAccessGrantsProperty is typed as Eloquent\Collection but returns collect(), and render() always calls it, so the queues page throws a TypeError whenever no access modal is open.
The change has no tests at all, missing the required happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
The members page tabs (activeTab, setActiveTab, tablist, invite form only on the invites tab) are not implemented.

The waiting list is rendered for any entity queue in selectedQueueId without checking the `call` permission, which leaks other queues' tickets to employees; a foreign id also gives a 404 instead of ui.serve_empty.
rename() passes null as the slug instead of re-deriving it from the new name.
`@can('\App\Models\Queue::class', ...)` names a non-existent ability, so the Queues nav link never appears.
callNext has no rate limit, and `mode` is unvalidated, so a tampered value makes CallMode::from throw a 500.
The contract is broken: editingQueue instead of editingQueueId, startRename/toggleActive take no $id, and no rename input is rendered, so rename is unusable from the UI.
Many user-facing strings are hard-coded English instead of lang keys, and ui.serve_call_next / ui.serve_empty are not used in the view.
Queue rows are clickable divs, not the required `<button class="button is-fullwidth p-3 mb-2">`, and lack accessible labels.
lastCalledTicketId must not be writable by the client but is not marked #[Locked].
Duplicate class attributes on the mode buttons mean the active style is never applied.
Role comparison uses ->value in one place and the enum in the other, so one of the two checks is wrong.
There is one query per queue to check grants, duplicating the QueuePolicy `call` logic.
Unused imports, and fully qualified class names used despite the imports.

review.summary: The change adds Queues and Serve Livewire components, lang keys, routes and nav links. Domain writes go through the actions, scoped to the entity. But the queues page crashes on every render (wrong return type on accessGrants), the members tabs are missing, rename doesn't re-derive the slug, the Queues nav link never shows, the serve list leaks tickets of queues the user can't call, rate limiting is missing, and there are no tests. This needs to be rejected or substantially reworked.
